history.description: Include up to 50 newest-first document revisions with total and truncation status. Omitted or false leaves the response unchanged.

media.description: Opt in to complete base64 media up to 524288 raw bytes. Larger files return null content with too_large and truncated true.

frame.description: Generated frame basename, required only for media: frame (for example 0000.png).

document.description: Select the source body (default) or summary.md. Line anchors are checked against the selected document; the summary field always returns the complete summary when available.
